evidence: dead_air: Hook and seg0 (0.3s to 4.4s) are the same ranking scene, where the only motion is Data sliding along each row. In seg4:start to seg4:end (27.8s to 31.3s) the ruler stays fixed and Data just stands on the ladder.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg4:mid and seg4:end a ruler with '50% apart' runs between two posts. The 75% label is printed over the 25% label. The closing line about Alaska gets no picture of Alaska at all.

weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the closing show Alaska's 130 volcanoes as most of the US's 165. For example, Data pulls Alaska off the US pile and the remaining 35 shrink to almost nothing, so the joke that Alaska is 'quietly winning' lands. Remove the '50% apart' figure and keep every label clear of the others.
